source_commit_caveat: No source VCS commit was supplied; provenance is anchored by the immutable V5.3 reviewed ZIP SHA-256 plus prior reviewed baseline identities.
final_archive_sha256_caveat: The SHA-256 of a ZIP cannot be embedded into that same ZIP without changing it; the delivery response and external review handoff provide the final archive hash.

security_claim_model.prevention: only actions rejected before mutation by the shipped installer/state-write mechanisms

integration_note: Manual unpack and installed reference mode select the same versioned external payload/state through INSTALLATION.json under an explicitly active CODEX_HOME; installer mode adds transactional ownership/rollback while the manual path uses a read-only preflight and operator steps; PROJECT_REFERENCE_OPT_IN.md provides a no-install advisory workflow.
writer_model: one-writer-per-git-common-dir; linked worktrees sharing refs are serialized; concurrent writers require independent Git common directories
